allowed_changes: use exact frozen SPY adjusted-close and TLT adjusted-close total-return proxies
use existing CNY gold and CashYieldCNY
target 25% SPY, 25% TLT, 25% gold and leave 25% cash
rebalance only at first common session of each calendar year
comparison_gates: Sharpe > SPY buy-and-hold on matched total-return/FX window
expected_outputs: Permanent Portfolio, SPY buy-hold and cash CSVs
trade count, actual gross, minimum cash and fingerprint
follow_up_policy: After any formal metric is viewed, do not alter the 25/25/25/25 weights, rebalance cadence, or add timing filters. Any Golden Butterfly/risk-parity/QQQ variant is a separately motivated architecture, not rescue tuning.
forbidden_changes: substituting QQQ for SPY after results
replacing TLT or gold after results
shorting, borrowing, financing, leverage or gross exposure above 100%
hypothesis: A fixed 25% allocation to broad U.S. equities, 25% long-duration U.S. Treasuries, 25% gold and 25% cash spans growth, deflation, inflation/stress and liquidity regimes without forecasting which regime comes next. Annual rebalancing can harvest cross-asset mean reversion at very low turnover while the permanently reserved cash sleeve constrains drawdown, all without leverage or shorting.
pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have Sharpe >0
max realized gross <=100% and minimum cash >=0
research_basis: Harry Browne Permanent Portfolio architecture: equal structural exposure to stocks, long-term bonds, gold and cash; used here as a fixed independent architecture rather than a weight search
selection_metric: No allocation or rebalance search. Exactly 25/25/25/25 and annual rebalance. Validation, objective and SPY comparison are independent ATM-SVP-3 axes.

shared_rules.rebalance: first common session each calendar year
